command: opencode serve, then POST /session and DELETE /session/<id> against it
note: `session.deleted` is reachable ONLY through the server's HTTP API. The plugin listens on opencode's in-process event bus, and `opencode session delete` edits the SQLite store from its own process — verified to fire NOTHING even with a plugin-loaded `serve` running. Costs no model turn: a session's creation and deletion are the whole scenario, which is why this is two payloads and not a run.
